text: Swimming, the ancient art of swimming, has been practiced for thousands of years. Kicking first requires the use of muscles, while breathing later is achieved through the use of lungs. Swimmers use their hands and arms to propel themselves through the water, while their lungs provide oxygen to sustain their buoyancy and propulsion. Swimming is a sport that requires both physical endurance and mental focus, making it an excellent exercise for anyone looking to improve their fitness and overall health.
